subject: Skyline Q4 close — preflight capacity escort & activation
messages:
From: Jane Liu <jane.liu@skylinepartners.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@skylinepartners.com
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short standby activation for Q4 close (Skyline)

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We are in the final contracting window for our Q4 go-live and need a short runway to validate end-to-end latency with our largest prompt mix. Can Redwood put a 14-day standby activation (soft hold) on a small dedicated slab we can burst into?

Key asks:
- Equivalent of 4 H100 GPUs (or A100x8 ops mix) reserved for 14 days starting Nov 15
- Ability to burst up to 8 GPUs for a 48-hour load test window during that period
- Slice mapping by availability zone (we are US-only)

We understand this is conditional on final SOW signing (expected by Nov 12). Please advise what you need from our side to flag capacity and any expected fees for a short standby.

Attaching the Skyline testing matrix.

—Jane
Jane Liu
Director, ML Infrastructure
Skyline Partners
Attachment: skyline_test_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jane Liu <jane.liu@skylinepartners.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: short standby activation for Q4 close (Skyline)

Thanks Jane — copying infra/ops to scope. Ben / Karthik, heads-up: Skyline wants a 14-day soft hold starting Nov 15 with a 48-hr 8-GPU burst window. They expect to sign by Nov 12.

Questions for ops sizing:
- Can we site a 4-GPU slab (H100-equivalent) in us-west-2 with the requested burst to 8 GPUs?
- If we map a so-called "standby slab" to them, what is the expected T-minus lead to activate (both on Dedicated and Dedicated+Burst)?
- Any expected charge model for a 14-day soft hold (we've done daily fee or small % of committed)?

Ben — could you run a quick availability scan and attach the node mapping snapshot? Karthik — if we need to pre-provision a slice (to avoid allocation churn), what's the minimum commit we should require?

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Sr. Dir, Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
Attachment: skyline_test_matrix.pdf (from Jane)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jane Liu <jane.liu@skylinepartners.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: short standby activation for Q4 close (Skyline)

Mina / team — ran an availability sweep across us-west-2 and us-east-1 for H100-capable nodes. Snapshot:
- us-west-2: 6 H100-like GPUs in hot pool; 12 in standby pool (recommended for 14-day soft hold)
- us-east-1: 4 H100-like GPUs in hot pool; 8 in standby pool

Options:
1) Soft hold mapped to a standby pool slice in us-west-2: reserve 4 GPUs (standby) + configured burst to 8 (subject to short-lived rebalancing). Lead time to full activation: ~24 hours.
2) Hard pre-provision: allocate 4 GPUs (pinned) to Dedicated slab for Skyline. Lead time: immediate, but requires minimum 30-day billing or a negotiated short-term premium.

Operational notes:
- Bursting may require transient rebalancing that could push latency SLOs during the 48-hr window; recommend a controlled canary approach for the load test.
- Node mapping attached: node_mapping_q4.xlsx (contains AZ-level TTL and GPU SKU mix).

If we go soft-hold, suggested fee: 15% of one-day pro-rated dedicated rate per GPU per day (covers standby ops costs). If they commit to a 30-day minimum we can waive the fee and convert to pre-provision.

Thumbs up from my side for the standby slice.
—Ben
Ben Carter
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
Attachment: node_mapping_q4.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jane Liu <jane.liu@skylinepartners.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: short standby activation for Q4 close (Skyline)

Quick follow-up on allocation policy and rollback:
- If we mark 4 GPUs as standby in us-west-2, ops will tag them with a soft-lock label (skyline_dl_1197). That prevents allocation to new commitments but allows emergency preemption if there is a genuine capacity emergency with higher-priority customers.
- Recommend we include an automatic fallback to an A100-equivalent slab in us-east-1 if activation fails in us-west-2. We should also add a short canary test (100 concurrent requests, 90th percentile latency target) before approving the 48-hr burst.

Mina — happy to draft the short appendix for the SOW (standby terms + fee schedule + preemption policy). Laura — can you handle tagging & billing flags if we approve the soft hold?

Karthik
Head of Capacity Planning — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jane Liu <jane.liu@skylinepartners.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: short standby activation for Q4 close (Skyline)

Mina / team — confirming we have flagged the standby slice:
- Flag: skyline_dl_1197 (soft-lock) mapped to 4 H100-equivalent GPUs in us-west-2; burst policy configured to allow up to 8 GPUs for a contiguous 48-hour window.
- Activation window requested: Nov 15–Nov 29 (14 days). Bursting interval scheduled for Nov 20–Nov 22.
- Fee: pro-rated standby fee applied at 15% per GPU/day unless they sign SOW for 30+ days, in which case fee converts to zero and charges roll into committed billing.

Attachments uploaded to the deal folder: capacity_runbook_v2.pdf, node_mapping_q4.xlsx

Next steps for Mina: please confirm terms with Jane and ask legal to append the standby appendix to the SOW (I can share the draft). Jane — if Nov 12 signature looks likely, we will keep the soft-lock in place and proceed to activation on Nov 15. If the SOW delays beyond Nov 14 we will need explicit exec approval to extend the standby.

Laura Bennett
Capacity Ops Lead — Redwood Inference
Attachment: capacity_runbook_v2.pdf
